description: The JEGS Inside Deburring Tool cleans up and chamfers the inside edge of 1/8 in. to 3/4 in. I.D. tubing and pipe, helping fittings seat correctly and preventing cuts from sharp burrs. description: The JEGS Crankshaft Key indexes the crankshaft to the timing gear and harmonic balancer, helping keep ignition timing stable and repeatable on Small Block Chevy engines with two crankshaft keyways. This short-style, stock-replacement set is ideal when original keys wear, letting the gear-to-dampener relationship shift and timing drift under load. Includes two natural-finish keys, sized for an OE-like fit: 3/4 in length, 3/16 in thickness, and 0.300 in height—built for two-keyway SBC setups. Install with confidence.

description: The JEGS Carburetor Adjuster Tool is built to make accurate carburetor idle speed and air/fuel mixture screw changes fast and frustration-free, even when the screws sit deep in a crowded engine bay. ebay_title: JEGS 60901 Transmission Filter and Gasket Kit

ebay_title: JEGS 78538 Fuel Tank Sending Unit Filter for 1954-1988 GM Cars and Trucks

description: The JEGS Fuel Tank Sending Unit Filter strains debris right at the sending unit pickup, stopping rust and sediment before they enter the fuel line—helping protect your fuel pump and carburetor while supporting smooth, consistent fuel delivery. The lightweight, durable strainer is a smart upgrade for restorations, restomods, and weekend cruisers, reducing clogs and keeping the system cleaner longer.

ebay_title: JEGS 60195 Universal Leaf Spring Perches

description: The JEGS Leaf Spring Perches provide a secure, weld-on mounting point on your rear axle housing so leaf springs sit correctly—ideal for axle swaps, replacing worn or cut-off perches, or moving springs inward for more tire clearance. Sold as a 2-piece set for one axle; U-bolts not included, ready for custom builds, restorations, and off-road abuse.

description: The JEGS Intake Manifold/Alternator Bracket Stud mounts on the front of the intake manifold to create a sturdy alternator bracket mounting point for 1969-1970 Big Block Chevy engines, restoring factory-correct accessory alignment and reducing bracket flex under load. description: The JEGS Fuel Pump Pushrod transfers camshaft motion to the mechanical fuel pump arm, keeping fuel delivery consistent as engine speed climbs.
